Record a command sound

Each command has one reference blueprint: an ordered sequence of chunks built from its recordings. Corresponding chunks are aligned before their MFCC fingerprints are averaged. Repeated saves of the same recording count once. This is experimental sound matching, not speech transcription. Nothing is sent to an outside service.

Your recorded blueprint

Tests are saved with their sound in chunktest, but are not added to the reference library. References and tests use Type 2 amplitude, Sensitive, dead zone 0.075: samples from −0.075 to +0.075 are ignored for chunk detection. The most central recording supplies the chunk sequence; aligned chunks from other recordings contribute average fingerprints and majority types. Extra unmatched chunks are not added to that scaffold. Commands with one recording are single-example references, not learned averages. Original experimental data is preserved.
